theta_IS_reference: Moniruzzaman et al. (2020) Remote Sensing 13(1):83 [in your verified literature review] documents impervious surface runoff increase in Dhaka; general value 0.70-0.90 from rational method standard for dense urban areas (USDA TR-55 1986; also Chow et al. 1988 Applied Hydrology). Full sensitivity range 0.60-0.85 reported.
theta_drain_note: θ_drain = 0.65 REMOVED from BHRR formula — no Dhaka-specific citation available. BHRR now computed from impervious surface term only (conservative lower bound). This is the more defensible approach.
delta_A_impervious_method: Dewan & Yamaguchi (2008/2009) EMnA — built-up area 53.7% of study area in 2005 (~164 km² within 304 km² DNCC+DSCC boundary). ESA WorldCover 2021 confirms 163.59 km². ΔA_impervious = ESA 2021 built-up (163.59 km²) minus Dewan 2005 baseline (≈164 km² × 304/total). Use ESA 2021 vs. estimated 2000 baseline from Dewan 2009 APGEOG.
canal_width_reference: Average major khal width in Dhaka estimated at 6-10m from Ishtiaque et al. (2014) GeoScape 8(2):48 — already in your verified literature review. Central estimate 8m adopted.
